issue.title: Bug: `gnoi-shutdown` service `exec-condition` skip is causing SYSTEM_READY to be not set

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The `exec-condition` which checks for platforms in :
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-host-services/blob/abb627d5fc73eca882996efc855ecc1e306ff3af/data/debian/sonic-host-services-data.gnoi-shutdown.service#L9
Is skipped on non-smartswitch NPU platforms. but because of this exec-condition skip this causes SYSTEM_READY to be set to down because this is a `simple` daemon service which is being monitored

It would only work if the service is masked,

### Steps to Reproduce

Install image with `gnoi-shutdown` PR and check whether SYSTEM_READY is set. We can check the state using
`show system-health sysready-status` output:
```
root@sonic:/home/admin# show system-health sysready-status
System is not ready - one or more services are not up

Service-Name                       Service-Status    App-Ready-Status    Down-Reason
---------------------------------  ----------------  ------------------  --------------
gnoi-shutdown                      Down              Down                exec-condition
```
This prevents control plane state to be down in case of generic implementation because we subscribe for `SYSTEM_READY` to be set

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behaviour:
```
root@sonic:/home/admin# show system-health sysready-status
System is not ready - one or more services are not up

Service-Name                       Service-Status    App-Ready-Status    Down-Reason
---------------------------------  ----------------  ------------------  --------------
gnoi-shutdown                      Down              Down                exec-condition
```

Expected Behavior:
```
root@sonic:/home/admin# show system-health sysready-status
System ready

Service-Name                       Service-Status    App-Ready-Status    Down-Reason
---------------------------------  ----------------  ------------------  --------------
gnoi-shutdown                      Up              Up
```

resolution.title: Fix for issue #25161 Bug:  service  skip is causing SYSTEM_READY to be not set
resolution.description:
Description:

Fix for issue #25161 Bug:  service  skip is causing SYSTEM_READY to be not set
fixes #25161

#### Why I did it
system-health was treating systemd “skipped due to ExecCondition” (Result=exec-condition) as a failure, so gnoi-shutdown showed Down (exec-condition) on non-SmartSwitch and incorrectly kept SYSTEM_READY DOWN.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
In sysmonitor.py:get_unit_status(), I added a small check so that when ActiveState=inactive and Result=exec-condition, the service is marked OK/OK (not applicable) instead of Down, preventing it from blocking system readiness.

#### How to verify it
Restart system-health.service and confirm systemctl status gnoi-shutdown still shows Result=exec-condition but show system-health sysready-status / sysreadyshow now report gnoi-shutdown OK/OK and SYSTEM_READY becomes UP (assuming no other real failures).

Tested on:
Smartswitch: Platform: x86_64-8102_28fh_dpu_o-r0   HwSKU: Cisco-8102-28FH-DPU-O
Non-Smartswitch: Platform: x86_64-8122_64eh_o-r0  HwSKU: Cisco-8122-O128S2
[Issue-#25161-ut-log.rtf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24897480/Issue-.25161-ut-log.rtf)

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)
- [x] 202506
- [x] 202511

#### Tested branch
master
root@sonic:/home/admin# show ver | grep Ver
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.master.33345-dirty-20251214.205827
SONiC OS Version: 12

#### Description for the changelog
Treat systemd units skipped due to ExecCondition (Result=exec-condition) as non-failures in system-ready monitoring so they don’t block SYSTEM_READY on unsupported platforms.
